description_en: Sends a voice file notification or video file notification to a single called number
description_zh: 调用接口给单个被叫号码发送语音文件通知或视频文件通知
name: SingleCallByVideo

parameters.help_en:
The China calling number (the number displayed to the called party) used to send the video notification.

If you use a calling number in common pattern, leave this parameter empty. For more information about common pattern, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172104.html.
If you use a calling number in private pattern, specify your real number or virtual number.
Log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal). On the Real Number Management page, view the purchased real numbers. On the Virtual Number Management page, view the virtual numbers that have been created and associated with real numbers
parameters.help_zh:
发送视频通知的外呼号码（被叫显号）。

如果您使用的外呼号码是公共模式，该参数不填。公共模式详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172104.html。
如果您使用的外呼号码是专属模式，请传入您的真实号码或虚拟号码。
您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)，在真实号管理页面查看已购买的真实号，在虚拟号管理页面查看已创建并绑定真实号的虚拟号
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en:
The called number that receives the video notification.

Number format:

Mobile number. Example: 159****0000.

Landline number. Example: 0571****5678.

International area code + number. Example: 85200****00
parameters.help_zh:
接收视频通知的被叫号码。

号码格式：

手机号码。示例：159****0000。

固话号码。示例：0571****5678。

国际区号+号码。示例：85200****00
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The voice ID of the voice notification file.

Log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home) and obtain the voice ID from the following pages. The voice notification file must have passed the review.

Obtain the Voice ID on the Voice Messaging > Voice Notification > Voice Notification Files page.

Obtain the Voice ID on the Voice File Management > Voice Notification Files page
parameters.help_zh:
语音通知文件的语音ID。

您登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)在以下页面获取语音ID，该语音通知文件必须已审核通过。

在语音消息>语音通知>语音通知文件页面获取语音ID。

在语音文件管理>语音通知文件页面获取语音ID
parameters.name: voice_code

parameters.help_en: The number of times the notification file is played. Valid values: 1 to 3
parameters.help_zh: 通知文件的播放次数。取值范围：1~3
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The volume at which the notification file is played. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 通知文件播放的音量。取值范围：0~100，默认取值100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The playback speed of the voice file. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 语音文件播放的语速。取值范围：-500~500
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en:
The custom ID reserved for the caller when initiating the request. This ID is returned to the caller through the receipt message.

The value is a string with a length of 1 to 15 characters
parameters.help_zh:
发起请求时预留给调用方的自定义ID，最终会通过回执消息将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度限制为1~15个字符
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video notification file.

You can view the IDs of approved video notification files on the Video Notification Files (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/notify) page
parameters.help_zh:
视频通知文件的ID。

您可以在视频通知文件 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/notify)页面，查看已审核通过的视频通知文件ID
parameters.name: video_code
